name: Research Design System
summary: Design-reference selector for research outputs: a pinned, hash-verified index of 84 design-system analyses (DESIGN.md files) from VoltAgent/awesome-design-md, categorized as reference material - not skills, not brand themes, not brand assets. The user picks one material; the workflow fetches only that file at the pinned revision, verifies its sha256, caches it for offline use, distills the prose into a reviewable token candidate, and binds it to an output revision only after confirmation. Original OpenAR workflow; the analyses stay upstream and read-only.

summaryI18n.zh-CN: 科研产出的设计参考选择器：钉版并逐文件哈希校验的 84 份设计系统分析（DESIGN.md，来自 VoltAgent/awesome-design-md）索引，归类为参考资料——不是技能、不是品牌主题、不含品牌资产。用户挑选一份后，才按钉住版本取回该文件、校验 sha256、本地缓存供离线使用，把分析提炼为可审阅的 token 候选，确认后才绑定到产出版本。工作流为 OpenAR 原创编写；分析原文留在上游、只读。

permissionsNote: The workflow fetches exactly one upstream DESIGN.md, only after the user picks it, from the pinned revision recorded in the index; OpenAR enforces its own permission gates on any network access.
